```yaml
name: Merge dev into features/hubs-recs

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      comment:
        description: 'Optional comment for the merge commit'
        required: false
        default: ''

jobs:
  merge:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"

      - name: Merge dev into features/hubs-recs
        env:
          COMMENT: ${{ github.event.inputs.comment }}
        run: |
          git fetch origin dev
          git checkout features/hubs-recs
          commit_msg="Merge dev into features/hubs-recs"
          if [ -n "$COMMENT" ]; then
            commit_msg="$commit_msg - $COMMENT"
          fi
          git merge --no-ff dev -m "$commit_msg"

      - name: Push changes
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          git push origin features/hubs-recs

      - name: Verify build
        run: pwsh -c "Write-Host 'Running build step placeholder...'"
        shell: pwsh
```
